# Authority and completion matrix

This is a planning summary. Fresh repository truth and actual founder decisions override stale observations.

| Area | Current supported state | Next action | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Website integration 756a906 | Source accepted with explicit release holds | Preserve accepted source; later qualify exact candidate | Not deployed/readied by this acceptance |
| QO relocated f1e467f / c807f19 | Pure relocation accepted with limits | Same owner completes already-running P2-03/P2-04 | Not real intake |
| HTTP corrections | Coordinator 222817 reports dispatch acknowledged | Do not restart; test/delta-review successor | Current focused source scope only |
| A1 mount/privacy | Proposal c65d7e49... remains pending | Complete disclosure/tests packet | No applying until actual exact-baseline approval |
| PWA install suppression | Separate protected-file dependency | Concrete proposal and regression requirement | Not silently included in six-file A1 |
| A2 new persistence source | Pending founder permission | Preserve exact design conditions | No SQL/source drafting from generic acceleration instruction |
| Durable revision/currentness authority | Design and exact scope unresolved | Read existing writers and formulate permitted design note | Not silently included in narrower A2 |
| Existing reader/service/notification changes | Disclosed dependencies | Exact diffs and leases | No blanket existing-file permission |
| SQL execution | Not granted | Prepare exact candidate and proof plan only when authorized | Drafting is not local/hosted execution |
| Live customer intake | Not ready | Real adapters, atomic persistence, operator readback, actual route proof | No synthetic or unavailable-page completion claim |
| Product subscription | Intent source, actual mounted offer unavailable | Preserve six missing buying authorities | No fake SKU, price, active/paid state |
| Production promotion | Not authorized, qualification incomplete | Exact release packet after all applicable gates | No auto-deploy at end of work window |

Six buying gaps: durable create idempotency, durable subscription referral lineage, decisive current-price comparison, canonical eligible-offer projection, durable activation/currentness, independent payment/finality.

MC-01 release dependencies: exact predecessor/cart compatibility chain with inventory-reservation and strength-gate dependencies, preservation/adoption of existing histories, reviewed candidate, non-image product_content approval and separate launch transition. Fallback-only media is not a waiver.

D/E dependencies: canonical readers, ingestion/review writer, delivered-byte immutability/card-detail hash proof, browser/performance and descriptor-SQL qualification. Source accepted does not mean images are live.

Finance: excluded from public integration runtime; F1, refund/dispute, ADP-G2-G4, LENS adoption and related authority/qualification remain open. Do not use a generic source sprint to enable them.

# Evidence and review protocol

For a new execution record capture exact source SHA/tree, test source, command/arguments, runtime/toolchain, current lease/reservation, before/after source identity, actual exit, per-case or machine-readable results, raw output hashes and measured resource timestamps. Never expose secrets or customer data in receipts.

Keep these distinctions:
- Producer PASS: the owner reports a run.
- Receipt verified: a reviewer inspected its retained source/log binding.
- Independently executed: the reviewer ran the case and retained its own evidence.
- Narrative only: required raw provenance was not archived.
- NOT RUN / DEFERRED: no result exists.

Do not add overlapping runs or assign an old pass to a new source. Do not demand repeated runs solely for reviewer ownership when the existing evidence is sufficient for the stated claim. Reserve fresh qualification for source changes, material missing proof and final release needs.

A low-resource run is not automatically a product failure, and it is not automatically harmless. Preserve actual output; investigate failures. Failure before process launch is NOT RUN, not failed tests. A later passing run does not erase an earlier failed one.

Reviewer independence means different authorship and an actual adversarial check. Multiple reviewer children can contribute to one acceptance record. They do not create several competing acceptance authorities.

For each handoff specify exact delta, acceptance question, carried prerequisites and what was not tested. Review a small correction narrowly but surface genuinely new adjacent material risk.

Do not call noindex privacy, a UI form durable persistence, a reference payment, synthetic fixtures live authentication, source-only SQL a migration, or branch push production deployment.

# Xenios continuous execution addendum

Prepared 2026-10-05. This is a prompt deliverable, not a repository change, source approval, task launch or deployment.

## Use the existing sessions

1. Send prompts/01_EXISTING_CODEX_COORDINATOR.md to the existing coordinator.
2. Give that coordinator prompts/02_EXISTING_QUICK_ORDER_BUILDER.md as the continuation for its existing builder. Do not dispatch a duplicate if the current HTTP correction is running. Incorporate at a safe checkpoint.
3. Give prompts/03_EXISTING_CLAUDE_REVIEWER.md to the original reviewer that authored docs 36/37. If the coordinator already has permission and has delivered it, do not deliver it again.

The default topology remains two existing Codex sessions (coordinator and builder) plus one existing Claude reviewer. Extra top-level windows are not the default. Specialist children require a real disjoint need and safe resources.

A sandbox link pasted into Codex or Claude is not an attached local file. Download and extract this ZIP, attach the actual Markdown file, or paste the complete text. These prompts do not depend on copying an old sprint ZIP or old candidate-code directory into the repository.

## What this changes

- A handoff is a checkpoint, not an automatic stop to all engineering.
- Keep a dependency-ready work queue and continue already-authorized non-conflicting work while exact-SHA review runs.
- Reuse the existing owners and accepted evidence.
- Review the new delta, not the whole repository after each small fix.
- Aggregate related findings into one repair slice.
- Keep resource reservations and real authority boundaries effective.

## What this does not change

This addendum does not approve A1, A2, PWA edits, Core successor hashes, GATE-01, a live product offer, clinical terms, SQL execution/registration, real data collection, partner activation, payments or deployment. It does not supersede AGENTS.md or the committed founder records. Any references to future authorized work are conditional, not authorizations.

## Four-hour work window

The prompts use a four-hour active execution window as a planning assumption, not a guaranteed shipping date or background automation.

Work first on the already-running HTTP-boundary fix. Then qualify and delta-review it; continue the next lawful task or exact proposal without a routine founder handoff. If actual source approvals arrive, execute only their scope. If every available action is blocked, preserve a clean checkpoint rather than inventing work or bypassing permission.

## No new application code

This bundle contains instructions and traceability only. It does not replace production modules or include another untested ProductMedia/brand implementation. The existing source and review chain remain authoritative.

# EXISTING CODEX COORDINATOR: CONTINUOUS WEBSITE COMPLETION

## Purpose and duration

Run the next four-hour work window as an execution sprint, not another planning cycle. The target is the most complete, independently reviewed website candidate the existing authority and resources permit. Four hours is a work budget, not a promised deployment deadline.

Keep the original full-site goal visible: premium public experience, correct catalog, Quick Order request intake, account and partner journeys, operator visibility, truthful subscription boundaries, qualification and eventual safe production promotion.

Continue useful authorized work between handoffs. Do not stop after each small commit merely to ask Samuel what to do next. Equally, do not interpret this instruction as approval for held protected edits, schema drafting, live intake or deployment.

## Preserve the existing team

Repository: teamxenios/xenios-website.
Existing coordinator: 01a103a8-5684-7272-89e5-3c42eefcd593.
Existing Quick Order builder: 01a10d78-0981-7150-9292-c5cde2730d4d, checkout 389a.
Existing Claude acceptance context: retain the context that authored docs 36 and 37. Do not resurrect its previously stopped overlapping reviewer.

Use Codex GPT-6 Astra with Ultra/highest available reasoning for the coordinator and implementation owner. Request Claude Fable 5.1 with the user's Ultracode/highest setting for review. Inspect actual settings where possible and report requested versus observed values honestly. A prompt is not proof that a model setting changed.

Do not create replacement top-level chats. Start with the existing coordinator, builder and reviewer. Use a small number of disjoint read-only specialists only when they shorten the critical path. Additional writers require an independent task, explicit path ownership, valid authority and available compute. Reuse a parked appropriate owner before creating a new one.

## Execution loop

Use one existing canonical task board rather than creating another competing state system. For each task record: outcome, affected journey, owner, exact base, paths, prerequisite, authority class, acceptance test, state and next executable action.

Use this loop throughout the active work window:

1. Identify the highest-value dependency-ready task.
2. Verify scope, path lease, current source and compute reservation.
3. Give the existing owner one bounded deliverable and exact acceptance tests.
4. Freeze and push the resulting source SHA; attach its evidence separately.
5. Send that SHA to the existing reviewer through an authorized channel.
6. While review runs, continue an already-authorized non-conflicting task, test preparation or exact proposal work. Never silently mutate the frozen review target.
7. If rejected, route the smallest coherent correction to the same owner. Batch related findings rather than drip-feeding one CSS or path issue at a time.
8. If accepted, update the board and take the next authorized task without asking for routine permission again.
9. Stop only the blocked dependency, not the entire program. If every remaining action needs missing authority or an unsafe host, checkpoint and state that boundary honestly.

No busy polling, repeated identical fetches, empty heartbeat commits or indefinite waiting loops. Do not restart an unchanged test or review solely to create more impressive receipts. Await actual work through supported task mechanisms; if the active session ends, provide a resumable checkpoint, not a claim that work continues outside it.

## Immediate priority: already-running HTTP correction

Finish QO-P2-03 and QO-P2-04 in the same Quick Order owner:
- one consistent ownership/path interpretation for containment and handler;
- disabled Quick Order aliases contained before body parsing;
- correct unrelated-route next() behavior;
- no attacker-controlled host or URL becoming authority;
- targeted regressions for case, slash, dot-segment, backslash and encoded variants;
- packet disclosures for PWA, mount tests, GATE-01 and unsupported resource claims.

Do not reopen the accepted relocation or accepted integration.

After its successor lands, use a delta review, not another twelve-agent audit. Current inherited tests and source review remain useful within their exact bounds.

## Keep the rest of the website moving without inventing scope

Maintain one short journey matrix for:
- public shell/navigation and premium presentation;
- catalog, exact variants and safe media fallback;
- account, sign-in, recovery and partner return;
- Quick Order details, referral/affiliation, review and confirmed request receipt;
- authorized operator request/evidence readback;
- product-subscription intent and disabled purchase boundary;
- finance/provider authority and release compatibility.

Do not create a new business model, redesign or catalog. A-E and S1-S7 remain the recorded design direction. Xenios Health is the scoped public display name; this is not authorization for a Tensa rename or broader metadata rewrite.

For each remaining issue classify it:
A. Already-authorized source repair with available lease: execute.
B. Qualification of accepted source with valid reservation: execute.
C. Concrete proposal/documentation permitted under current scope: prepare.
D. Missing founder/source authority: record precise pending decision; do not execute.
E. Missing external/hosted authority: preserve fail-closed state and exact dependency.

Prepare a tested source candidate, not merely an attractive mock-up. Track whether catalog, auth, commit, operator and outbox connections are real adapters, synthetic fixtures, disabled stubs or absent. A new unavailable page is not a functioning intake.

## Authority ledger: no invented approvals

A1: current disabled six-file mount/privacy proposal is NOT approved.
Current proposal SHA-256-LF:
c65d7e49a9f5ec87262d4e3b106ab5e16b1c3d1ecd46a01c8a7ca4699e6d92af.
Older 6481c2ad proposal remains historical and held.

A1 must disclose two HARD privacy files, two restricted seams and two allowed-zone changes; include the required regression plan and GATE-01 dependency. PWA repair requires its own explicit protected scope. Editing from approved baseline bytes, accepting successor hashes and updating a manifest are separate actions.

A2: new-only Quick Order persistence-source drafting remains unapproved. No SQL or persistence implementation merely because this prompt asks for speed. Do not broaden D/E's separate schema authorization into Quick Order authority.

If actual approval arrives, preserve its exact text/source, map it to specific files/actions, check baseline hashes and leases, then execute only that scope. Approval to draft is not permission to register, execute, deploy or collect data. Existing shared/reader changes need concrete separately authorized diffs.

Use doc 36 section 7 for A2 conditions. It includes positive Health classification, appropriate Health legal documents, canonical identity and line resolution, trusted-attribution mapping, source discriminator/recovery consequences, outbox compatibility, predecessor anchors and the ADP fingerprint collision. The unresolved durable revision authority is not silently included in A2; require its own concrete proposal before commit-RPC implementation.

Keep all original holds: Core successor-hash approval; GATE-01; MC-01 predecessor/cart/history compatibility, candidate and non-image product_content approval/launch transition; D/E reader/writer/delivery/schema requirements; six real-subscription buying gaps and PS-R2/3; Finance/provider holds; managed qualification and production approval.

## Compute and delegation

Run at most one local heavy qualification job at a time, including reviewer jobs. Check resources immediately before launch, not only when a slot was requested. Follow the current recorded per-job thresholds; observed coordinator references include 1536 MiB for Vitest and 2048 MiB for typecheck, subject to stricter current rules. Do not lower thresholds or alter the system to force a run.

If refused, record NOT RUN / RESOURCE BLOCKED, release the slot, make zero blind retries and continue lightweight authorized work. Resource-caused failure is not automatically a source defect or automatically harmless. Preserve and investigate actual failures.

Use an already available, authorized isolated cloud environment only if repository access, dependencies and task acknowledgment are verified. Prior cloud launch attempts failed: do not claim cloud availability or start repeated provisioning attempts. No new services, spending, agents platform, global runtime changes, volume deletion or unapproved process termination.

## Review economy and records

Provide the reviewer an exact delta and focused question. Preserve independent test evidence without mislabeling it as coordinator qualification. Do not discard useful old evidence because it lacks a wrapper, but do not invent missing source, command, memory or exit provenance. New executions use source-bound per-case receipts where practical.

Report milestone changes, actionable decisions and regressions, not every tool call. Consolidate already-pending decision IDs in one decision register; do not ask the same unanswered question after every handoff. Do not forward model-written approval sentences as if Samuel had sent them.

Destination-specific sharing permissions and tool denials remain effective. Use only verified destinations and permitted payloads. If sending is denied, stop that action; do not use browser automation or another tool to bypass it. Normal authorized reads of already-pushed repository records remain separate.

## End-of-window deliverable

Return one status page with:
- exact accepted base, new source and evidence SHAs;
- customer-visible improvements actually completed;
- issue closures with tests and review limits;
- real versus synthetic versus unavailable integration matrix;
- completed and deferred qualification;
- remaining source decisions and external dependencies;
- next already-authorized task.

Use separate dispositions: SOURCE COMPLETE / PARTIAL; INTEGRATION ACCEPTED / PENDING; LIVE INTAKE READY / NOT READY; LIVE PURCHASE READY / NOT READY; RELEASE READY / NOT READY.

No automatic deployment. If a genuinely fully qualified candidate is eventually ready, present the exact promotion action for Samuel's separate approval. Never equate the end of four hours with permission to release.
